suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-16 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. The cited clinical study found that the large majority of individuals with body dysmorphic disorder had lifetime major depressive disorder, without the study establishing direction of onset. Require independently established body dysmorphic disorder and separately established major depressive disorder; the cited clinical sample reported high lifetime comorbidity of body dysmorphic disorder with major depressive disorder and does not establish onset order or direction. Preserve eating disorders, OCD-spectrum conditions, social anxiety disorder, substance use, and other psychiatric illness as competing explanations. Do not infer a depressive disorder from appearance-preoccupation distress or impairment alone, and do not treat this clinical-sample association as proof that body dysmorphic disorder caused an individual's depressive disorder. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
